aria_snapshot:
- main:
  - region "Fire Babys":
    - img "Fire Babys title blazing above a fierce round fire creature and a burning fantasy castle"
    - heading "Fire Babys" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Tiny flames. Massive battles.
    - link "PLAY DEMO":
      - /url: "#demo"
    - text: Deploy • Merge • Burn
  - region "Play the demo":
    - text: Ready when you are
    - heading "Play the demo" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Take command. Move your hero, trigger Fire Nova, and torch the enemy castle.
    - iframe
    - link "Download the demo":
      - /url: https://muse.ai/files/1320763264456757/2287622778691195/473l4jygtvquds5k6q94hwud/FireBabys-demo.html
    - paragraph: It plays offline in any mobile browser.
    - paragraph: The demo file link refreshes periodically until the game is hosted on firebabys.io.
  - region "Meet the Babys":
    - text: The original six
    - heading "Meet the Babys" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Every flame has a role. Every flame has an attitude.
    - article:
      - img "Ruko, an orange-red round flame brawler with a mohawk crest and confident smirk"
      - heading "RUKO" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The Leader
      - text: Brawler Fist Flurry
      - paragraph: “Outta my way — I’m already on fire.”
    - article:
      - img "Blaze, a golden round flame hero wearing a small star crown and heroic grin"
      - heading "BLAZE" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The Star-Crowned
      - text: Hero · Your avatar Fire Nova
      - paragraph: “Follow me. Try to keep up.”
    - article:
      - img "Boulder, a deep magma-red round flame guardian with soft eyes and rocky shoulder plates"
      - heading "BOULDER" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The Gentle Wall
      - text: Guardian Magma Taunt
      - paragraph: “Nobody touches my friends. NOBODY.”
    - article:
      - img "Sizzle, a bright yellow-pink round flame archer with a flowing ponytail, playful wink, and bow"
      - heading "SIZZLE" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The Showoff
      - text: Girl Archer Spark Volley
      - paragraph: “Watch and learn, boys.”
    - article:
      - img "Cinder, a violet-red round flame pyro with twin ember buns and a mischievous grin"
      - heading "CINDER" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The Chaos Gremlin
      - text: Girl Pyro Meteor Drop
      - paragraph: “Hehehe... did that explode? GOOD.”
    - article:
      - img "Lord Inferno, a dark crimson-black round flame villain with a jagged black-fire crown and menacing grin"
      - heading "LORD INFERNO" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The Wildfire King
      - text: Boss Cataclysm Slam
      - paragraph: “Little flames. BOW.”
  - region "Build-a-Baby":
    - text: Make your flame
    - heading "Build-a-Baby" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Name it. Style it. Train it. Then put your creation in command.
    - text: 9,676,800 possible combinations
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - strong: 10 palettes
        - text: Eyes, brows, mouths & color
      - listitem:
        - strong: Full loadout
        - text: Headgear, torso gear & weapons
      - listitem:
        - strong: 6 classes
        - text: Archer, Knight, Heavy, Wizard, Strongman, Ogre
      - listitem:
        - strong: 8 specials
        - text: Pick the move that fits your fight
      - listitem:
        - strong: 12 points
        - text: Split across Power, Swift & Tough
      - listitem:
        - strong: 6 save slots
        - text: Build a whole custom roster
    - paragraph: Equip your custom Baby as your hero in battle.
  - region "How it plays":
    - text: Fight smart. Burn bright.
    - heading "How it plays" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - heading "Deploy & merge" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Build your squad into stronger tiers.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Watch armies clash" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Your formation fights on its own.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Drive the hero" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Use the joystick. Pop Fire Nova.
      - listitem:
        - heading "Burn the castle" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Climb stages. Face a boss every 5.
  - text: The fire is spreading
  - heading "Join the community" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Meet the crew, follow the build, and help shape what burns next.
  - link "JOIN ON FACEBOOK":
    - /url: https://www.facebook.com/groups/2333915794032995
- contentinfo:
  - region "Privacy":
    - heading "Privacy" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Privacy policy coming soon — the demo collects nothing.
  - region "Contact":
    - heading "Contact" [level=2]
    - paragraph:
      - link "contact@firebabys.io":
        - /url: mailto:contact@firebabys.io
  - paragraph: © 2026 Fire Babys
